As such, it cannot perform malicious actions on its own.

The use of a versioned release tarball (as opposed to a mutable branch) enhances reproducibility and reduces supply-chain risk. No `SKIP` checksums or dynamic git operations (e.g., `git pull`) are present. The package adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no evidence of malicious behavior.
